parts.name: Leg (Left Temple Arm)
parts.Basic_description: This is the left leg (temple arm) of the eyeglasses, made of acetate plastic, which is lightweight and flexible.
parts.Functional_description: It supports the glasses on the wearer’s ear and helps maintain stability and comfort during use.
parts.Movement_description: It can rotate around the hinge joint to fold inward for storage or open outward for wearing.

parts.name: Leg (Right Temple Arm)
parts.Basic_description: This is the right leg (temple arm) of the eyeglasses, made of acetate plastic, similar to the left leg.
parts.Functional_description: It provides balance and support on the opposite side of the head, ensuring the glasses stay in place.
parts.Movement_description: It can rotate around the hinge joint to fold inward for compact storage or open outward for wearing.

parts.name: Base Body (Frame and Lenses)
parts.Basic_description: This is the main body of the eyeglasses, including the frame and lenses, made primarily of polycarbonate and plastic.
parts.Functional_description: It holds the lenses in place and provides the optical correction or protection function of the eyeglasses.
parts.Movement_description: It remains stationary and serves as the central structure to which the legs are attached via hinges.
